title: 大型语言模型的概率归因方法
summary: 提出一种模型无关的概率性token归因度量，利用贝叶斯规则反转下一个token的对数概率，以捕捉模型对token序列分布的内部表示。通过计算给定提示下响应的条件概率与边际化一个token后的概率之比的对数作为归因分数，并计算熵以分析模型行为。在8个模型和7个提示上评估，提高了可解释性。
summary_en: Proposes a model-agnostic probabilistic token attribution measure using Bayes' rule to invert next-token log-probabilities, capturing the model's internal distribution over token sequences. The attribution score is the log ratio of conditional probabilities. Evaluated on 8 models and 7 prompts, improving interpretability.
